verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's docs say it exposes stored documents and embeddings through semantic search and conversational interfaces from a single API. Its hybrid-search docs describe automatic embedding generation and combined keyword and semantic retrieval, and dedicated product pages position it as a RAG retrieval layer and as conversational search grounded in your own content. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the conversational/answer endpoint (request/response shape, LLM configuration), RAG integration guides, and independent hands-on corroboration of the answer-generation feature.
